pilot_rule: existing complete TypeScript01-migration native/compat block; chosen before ranking; excluded from full-run summary
pilot_continuation_rule: complete run artifacts and integrity replay; quality/Partial/no-answer failures retained and do not tune or prevent remaining suites
configuration: unchanged suite repetitions/warmup/top_k/timeout/seed/source domains; MCP adapter fixed hybrid; product default features; no semantic/network
optional_process_tree_probe: disabled via CODECORTEX_BENCH_PROCESS_PROBE=0; native PID RSS separate; no peak certification

analysis_definitions.repetition_unit: arithmetic score mean within query; scheduled repetitions never multiply question N
analysis_definitions.micro: mean eligible per-query means; native answerable and compat separate; missing scheduled rows invalidates global aggregation
analysis_definitions.repository_macro: equal mean of nonempty fixed repo per-query means
analysis_definitions.category_macro: equal mean of nonempty frozen category per-query means
analysis_definitions.family_balanced: mean variants within frozen global correlation component; equal component weight within repo, then equal repo macro
analysis_definitions.paired_projection: join native and compat by fixed case ID; descriptive side-by-side existing scores, distinct formulas; not a candidate-minus-baseline intervention
analysis_definitions.strict_no_answer: normalized no_match and empty hits for every scheduled native no-answer row; failures/Partial incorrect
analysis_definitions.intervals: candidate-minus-baseline preregistered 10000 stratified family bootstrap NOT_RUN: only one product arm and two distinct scoring profiles
analysis_definitions.facet_graph_Recall20_SymbolAccuracy_Dupl: not_implemented/not_run; retain raw/normalized evidence, no proxy

environment.runtime_environment: allowlisted PATH/RUSTUP_HOME/CARGO_HOME/LANG/LC_ALL/TMPDIR/TZ only plus disabled optional probe; no API credentials forwarded
